svg.aria-label: integrix on the GeoStack role ladder: run and the history steppers as algorithms; no models of its own (the integrand is the caller's, in a diffrax term); adaptive rules, expectations, diffrax solvers, IMEX schemes and adjoints as strategies; sums, running integrals and step functions as primitives; and functax's rules as the structures; diffrax, optimistix and lineax and the setup names sit beside the ladder.
